name: Return of the soul
detailed_description:
The game tells the story of a boy who, after suffering an accident, ends up waking up in an unknown space. Even though he doesn't remember the accident, he continues his search for a way out of this unknown place, together with his protector who will guide him on this mysterious journey, in which the objective is to return his soul to the world where it belongs.

A 2D horror and combat game where you can explore spaces while solving poozles and facing enemies and traps.

In Return of the Souls you can expect simple mechanics and gameplay, as well as everything else, since it is a game made by one person, from the art, animations, soundtracks and the entire system. The game does not have any items that can be purchased with real money. Before purchasing the game, we advise users to watch the trailer and photos of the game, available on the page before purchasing it.

The game contains mini games, fighting, text dialogues, simple animations, simple soundtracks, effects, cutscenes and simple art, and does not have any store where you can spend real money within the game. Don't expect complexity from the game.

If you play, please leave your comment about the game on stean to help DEV improve the quality of future games. Thank you in advance!

!WARNING! The game contains sexual content, violence, foul language and triggers. If you have any problems, we recommend that you do not play this game. Please be warned!

If you have any questions about the game, please contact support for more information.
